svg.title: Branch points and cuts in air and an absorbing medium

cc:Work.dc:title: Branch points and cuts in air and an absorbing medium
cc:Work.dc:description: The four branch-cut rules overlaid in the kx plane. In air, branch point n=1 lies on the real axis. For absorbing ε=4+3i, it shifts to n=2.121+0.707i; the entire real axis lies outside the pale-orange Im(kz²)<0 region, and all four rules agree for real kx.
